تستعجلوا (form X)
# تَسْتَعْجِلُوا (tastaʕjilū) /tas.taʕ.d͡ʒi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
# تُسْتَعْجَلُوا (tustaʕjalū) /tus.taʕ.d͡ʒa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
